newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Few trades after up-and-down week.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Few trades after up-and-down week.

text.p: A wild week on Wall Street left traders eager to give the dust a chance to settle, so there was little action Friday after the bell, traders said.
"It's been a crazy week," one trader said. "Traders just ran home."

Even an interesting move by Knight-Ridder Inc drew little after-hours interest. Knight-Ridder said late Friday that it would pay the Walt Disney Co $1.65 billion for four newspapers. But there were few nibbles at Knight-Ridder.
"It's offering lower, but we have no trades yet," a trader said.
